ana: quick handoff before I board  planning to unpin runtime v3.4.2 -> canary-eu at 2026-05-03T22:00Z. leaving roll-forward / rollback notes.

tom: ack. What's the minimal rollback trigger set?

ana: Triggers: sustained 5xx >1.5% for 10m OR p95 latency >1100ms for 10m OR KV hit-rate<68% after warmup. If triggered -> rollback to runtime v3.3.10 and re-pin.

ria: add: SDK mismatch warning rate >8/min should also block (we saw kernel fallback before).

deploybot: ACTION: scheduled unpin runtime:v3.4.2 -> canary-eu at 2026-05-03T22:00:00Z. Manual rollback: `/deploybot rollback --to runtime:v3.3.10 --selector=canary-eu`

oncall: preflight smoke passing (50/50 quick checks), longseq queued. I'll watch dashboards 21:45-01:00 UTC. Ping `@oncall` here if critical.

tom: telemetry check: old-sdks ratio = 0.03 (3%) over 5m, safe. Use `telemetry.query --q "sdk_old_ratio_canary_eu"`.

ria: noted. After unpin run `scripts/check_sdk_compat.sh canary-eu` at +30m and paste results.

ana: thanks all  runbook: https://runbooks.redwood/internal/unpin-eu-canary. I'll be offline after 22:05 UTC.

oncall: deploybot will post start/complete. I'll escalate in #eng-oncall if any threshold crosses.

ana: over and out.
